svg.text: MV0-C05 / HR-V0-ARM-ARCH-P0.13-PAD-POCKET-STOP-CANDIDATE - PRELIMINARY - CANDIDATE GEOMETRY ONLY - NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION
Finished envelope: 48.00 x 80.00 x 9.525 nominal; 6061-T651 plate from held OnlineMetals 1249 stock.
Frame pattern: 4 x diameter 2.70 at X=+/-16, Z=+/-8 for the rolled S102 broad-face pattern
Structural/member pattern: 2 x diameter 8.50 at X=0, Z=+/-30 for the 40-4040 front T-slot
All hole coordinates are basic to the part center; coordinate tolerance +/-0.05 mm.
Hole diameters, thickness, flatness, parallelism, edge break and FAI controls are in the CSV schedule.
S102 pattern is checked against controlled FR13-S102K STEP/drawing dated 2026-01-07; column is 80/20 40-4040.
17-8520 plus 13035 are exact mounting-hardware candidates only; T-slot pullout, torque and proof remain open.
Received-part fit, exact stack, installation torque, locking, tool access and proof remain required.
Supplier DFM and one separately authorized first article precede any use on an assembly.
DO NOT FABRICATE, ASSEMBLE, CONNECT, OR ENERGIZE FROM THIS DRAWING ALONE.
Units: mm | Projection: plate face X-Z | Date: 2026-08-07
